verdicts.title: Minimal abelian varieties of algebras, I
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We show that any abelian variety that is not affine has a nontrivial strongly abelian subvariety. In later papers in this sequence we apply this result to the study of minimal abelian varieties.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract discusses 'abelian varieties of algebras' in universal algebra (strongly abelian subvarieties), which is unrelated to abelian integrals or communication complexity of Boolean functions. It shares only the word 'abelian' with the conjecture.
